message.utopia.ability.none: You have no abilities to toggle
message.utopia.unlock.level: Your overall level is too low
trait.utopia.class.engineer.desc: Cogs, shafts, contraptions. Starts with the Create basics and pays less for that tree.
trait.utopia.class.farmer.desc: Everyone eats because you plant. Seeds, hoe, water, patience.
trait.utopia.class.hunter.desc: Patient and quick. You bring down what you aim at, from a distance you choose.
trait.utopia.class.miner.desc: The deep is home. Torches, a good pickaxe, and nothing between you and bedrock.
trait.utopia.class.smith.desc: Iron bends for you. Bring the ore, leave with something worth carrying.
trait.utopia.class.survivor.desc: No specialty, no weakness. Extra points to become whatever the world needs.
trait.utopia.class.tank.desc: The wall. Shield up, kettle hat on, everything behind you stays alive.
trait.utopia.class.trader.desc: Emeralds in the pocket and a nose for a good deal.
trait.utopia.class.warrior.desc: Front line. Heavy blade, chainmail, and the confidence to walk into the fight first.
trait.utopia.class.wizard.desc: Robes, bottles, and a knack for making the world behave strangely.
trait.utopia.gender.female.desc: Faster and more agile. Carries Girl Power from the start.
trait.utopia.gender.transfem.desc: Start your transition in-game: brew estrogen to earn Girl Power permanently.
trait.utopia.origin.melon_citizen.desc: Cool-headed, quick-handed, and remarkably hard to set on fire.
trait.utopia.origin.neko.desc: Light on your feet and at home in the dark. Night vision can be switched off.
trait.utopia.origin.puppy.desc: Always lands well. Happiest with a hammer or a pickaxe in hand.
trait.utopia.origin.sea_citizen.desc: Born to the water. Swims with dolphin's grace, holds their breath twice as long, and sees clearly beneath the surface.
trait.utopia.origin.villager.desc: Bargains hard, heals fast, and always knows somebody.
